invariants.rationale: The method operates on 'nodes', so it is expected that it is not null.
y represents a coordinate (likely pixel or layout position), thus it is often non-negative.
rowY represents a vertical position (likely pixel or layout position), thus it is often non-negative at entry.
Array.size in libGDX is always non-negative.
If nodes is not empty, its first element should not be null for tree structure correctness.
